The reason I prefer the icosahedron is the transcriber's word 'edge' — the segments joining the vertices are stated to be edges of the solid, not added diagonals, and a cube's twelve edges would not be called 'many'. Marked MED rather than HIGH because I am working from a description of the figure, not the figure itself.
